housing.heading: Capital Gains Indexed to Pre-Inflation Prices
housing.quote: Dave will push for policy allowing homeowners to index capital gains to pre-inflation home prices, so families are only taxed on real gains, not on a number inflated by economic policies they had no control over.

health-care.heading: Absolute Price Transparency
health-care.quote: Dave supports requiring hospitals and insurers to post real, usable prices before a procedure happens, so a patients can compare costs at face value, the same way they'd compare prices on anything else they pay for out of pocket.

foreign-policy.heading: safety and security in our communities
